reviews.text: Very good

Honest and kind people.
They cared for my cat, treating him with great affection and making a quick and accurate diagnosis that saved his life.
Thank you.

I went to them for a problem with my dog. They resolved it immediately, with courtesy and professionalism. They have an excellent relationship with the dog, and great empathy (not always easy to find!). Highly recommended!

Excellent and competent! I know I'm in safe hands...and my dog ​​knows it too!

It's been three years since my first review. Breva and Yume are no longer with us, having lived an incredible life thanks in part to the vets who cared for them until their last breath. A year later, and still without any furry friends, my family and I have great respect for the entire team, always attentive, scrupulous, and humane. Thank you so much!

Our puppies are just like theirs! To all the staff... thank you for what you do and how you do it ❤️.
Maximum professionalism and availability.
Exceptional

I'm deeply moved by the professionalism and, above all, the humanity shown in trying to save my Maltese Milly! Unfortunately, we weren't able to save her, but the moral support and professional help offered to me in making a decision, albeit tragic, that would put an end to my dog's suffering was a great comfort. A special thanks to Dr. Andrea Bolzoni.

They are the "Guardian Angels" of our furry puppies.
The entire medical team is extremely professional... highly recommended.
I had a great time... The staff was friendly and professional.
Exquisite competence and kindness.
I've known them for ages. The doctors are friendly, competent, and professional. In difficult moments, they treat you like family. They're delightful.
Best clinic in Milan!

I wish I lived in Milan so I could go to this vet all the time. I can't even begin to express how grateful I am. While I was on vacation, my dog ​​got sick, and they saw us on a Saturday, without an appointment, and they spoke perfect Spanish. The care, empathy, and professionalism they showed my dog ​​were incredible. Plus, the price was much better than in Spain. I absolutely recommend this vet 100%. Thank you so much to all three of you, and especially to the woman who saw us.
optimal

I was here for the first time two weeks ago. I found the doctors to be very competent and kind, and you could tell they care about their work and, above all, the health of the animals.

Very helpful and friendly.

I highly recommend them.
Great professionalism
The guys are extremely kind and knowledgeable. I'm very happy with them... Pietrino is an absolute giant!

Professional and kind staff and veterinarians. Highly professional and, above all, compassionate (which never hurts!).
A round of applause for Claudio and Andrea. My boxer thanks you.
Good vets maybe a little expensive hello everyone have a good day
Doctors always available, adequate care and more than reasonable fees
They have been taking care of my dogs for over 30 years, friendly, reliable and hyper-competent.
The best doctors for our animal friends

I recommend it especially for Dr. Bolzoni and Dr. Lo Schiavo. They've cared for my cats and my dog ​​forever, ever since they still had their practice on Via Maiocchi. They were especially competent and prompt with Maya, resolving a serious health issue. A few months later, when another arose, they immediately identified the cause, successfully performing surgery under general anesthesia in both cases—a delicate procedure in itself, even more so for a brachycephalic dog who is no longer young.
They're empathetic with animals and friendly with us humans.
